question: Should Slacrawl enable this cross-repository ClawSweeper dispatch workflow with `pull_request_target` and the App-token credential boundary shown in this PR?
rationale: The requested automation intentionally grants a privileged workflow access to a secret-backed cross-repository token; whether that trust boundary is acceptable is a repository-owner decision, not a mechanical review outcome.

options.title: Approve after full workflow security review
options.body: Confirm that the dispatch payload and every invoked command remain independent of untrusted pull-request content, then merge the pinned workflow.

options.title: Use a reduced-permission dispatch design
options.body: Keep review dispatch but redesign the receiving or source workflow to avoid a cross-repository write-capable token on `pull_request_target`.

options.title: Defer the rollout
options.body: Pause this repository’s onboarding until the organization-wide workflow pattern has a separately approved security model.

recommendation.title: Approve after full workflow security review
recommendation.body: Confirm that the dispatch payload and every invoked command remain independent of untrusted pull-request content, then merge the pinned workflow.

likelyOwner.reason: The collaborator authored this organization-wide rollout workflow and is the best available routing candidate for its intended credential and dispatch model.
